target_audience: Your target customers are telecom service providers and the hyperscale cloud companies building AI networks, and leaders from each are in Formula 1: AT&T (Red Bull), Claro (Cadillac), Google (McLaren), Microsoft (Mercedes) and Oracle (Red Bull). market_reference: Your competitor in optical networking, Cisco (McLaren), has partnered with the team since 2021 and extended the deal in July 2026. flags: Capacity: firm caution. Q3 2026 revenue USD 281.2M (up 0.6%), GAAP operating margin -0.3%, operating cash outflow USD 24.5M and cash of USD 71.7M at 30 Sep 2026; also carries recurring compensation payments to Adtran Networks SE (ex-ADVA) minority holders under the domination agreement.

Q3 2026 release highlights growth in optical networking and with hyperscale customers.
No F1 sponsorship found.
